checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1 and itemized prices are also on page 1, which counts as placed correctly.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, notices, shelter of remains, permits and coordination with cemetery, crematory or other third parties.
No second mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead appears in the item labels or text.
D-embalming is on page 1 and the embalming price is also on page 1, which counts as placed correctly.
No text states that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service without viewing.
D-alt-container is on page 2 and the direct cremation price range is also on page 2, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation is offered with purchaser-provided container and alternative container options, with no statement that a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation but no separate crematory cash-advance charge is listed, so no double-billing is shown.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have their own priced lines, and no goods or services are mentioned only inside a package or description.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are required items, not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the prescribed disclosure wording.
No claim about delaying decomposition long-term or protecting the body from gravesite substances appears.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and no disclosure is shown printed in a hard-to-notice manner.
